description: This file defines a template class for HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) using various hash algorithms within the WPEFramework Crypto namespace. It includes methods for setting keys, resetting the state, and obtaining the HMAC result, along with typedefs for specific hash algorithm instantiations.

classes.name: HMACType
classes.description: A template class implementing HMAC with a specified hash algorithm, providing key management, input processing, and result retrieval.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the key for HMAC, hashing it if necessary, and prepares inner and outer pads.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal hash algorithm state and prepares for new input.

methods.name: Result
methods.description: Returns the computed HMAC value, performing final calculations if not already done.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Feeds data into the HMAC for processing.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators to input data into the HMAC.
